description: Test suite for scheduled post store functionalities in Mattermost, including creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion of scheduled posts within the store layer.

methods.name: TestScheduledPostStore
methods.description: Main test function executing various sub-tests for scheduled post store operations.

methods.name: testCreateScheduledPost
methods.description: Tests creation of scheduled posts, including scheduling in the past and future.

methods.name: testGetScheduledPosts
methods.description: Tests retrieval of pending scheduled posts with various time filters.

methods.name: testPermanentlyDeleteScheduledPosts
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple scheduled posts and verification of their removal.

methods.name: testUpdatedScheduledPost
methods.description: Tests updating specific fields of scheduled posts and handling of old scheduled posts.

methods.name: testUpdateOldScheduledPosts
methods.description: Tests marking old scheduled posts with error codes based on age.

methods.name: testPermanentDeleteScheduledPostsByUser
methods.description: Tests deletion of all scheduled posts for a specific user, including edge cases.
